named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.AccumulatedWork.lintegral_le_geometric
named_declarations.source_header:
theorem lintegral_le_geometric (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Nat → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    {q N : ℝ≥0∞}
    (initial : (∫⁻ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ) ≤ N)
    (drift : ∀ t, (∫⁻ ω, X (t + 1) ω ∂μ) ≤ q * (∫⁻ ω, X t ω ∂μ))
    (t : Nat) : (∫⁻ ω, X t ω ∂μ) ≤ q ^ t * N

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.AccumulatedWork.lintegral_tsum_shift_le
named_declarations.source_header:
theorem lintegral_tsum_shift_le (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Nat → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    {q N : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (X t) μ)
    (initial : (∫⁻ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ) ≤ N)
    (drift : ∀ t, (∫⁻ ω, X (t + 1) ω ∂μ) ≤ q * (∫⁻ ω, X t ω ∂μ))
    (w : Nat) :
    (∫⁻ ω, (∑' j : Nat, X (w + j) ω) ∂μ) ≤ q ^ w * N / (1 - q)

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.AccumulatedWork.lintegral_tsum_le
named_declarations.source_header:
theorem lintegral_tsum_le (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Nat → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    {q N : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (X t) μ)
    (initial : (∫⁻ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ) ≤ N)
    (drift : ∀ t, (∫⁻ ω, X (t + 1) ω ∂μ) ≤ q * (∫⁻ ω, X t ω ∂μ)) :
    (∫⁻ ω, (∑' t : Nat, X t ω) ∂μ) ≤ N / (1 - q)

    {q N : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (X t) μ)
    (initial : (∫⁻ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ) ≤ N)
    (drift : ∀ t, (∫⁻ ω, X (t + 1) ω ∂μ) ≤ q * (∫⁻ ω, X t ω ∂μ))
    (hq : q < 1) (hNtop : N ≠ ∞) :
    (∫⁻ ω, (∑' t : Nat, X t ω) ∂μ) < ∞

named_declarations.name: Applications.Probability.AccumulatedWork.measure_tsum_ge_le
named_declarations.source_header:
theorem measure_tsum_ge_le (μ : Measure Ω) (X : Nat → Ω → ℝ≥0∞)
    {q N : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hmeas : ∀ t, AEMeasurable (X t) μ)
    (initial : (∫⁻ ω, X 0 ω ∂μ) ≤ N)
    (drift : ∀ t, (∫⁻ ω, X (t + 1) ω ∂μ) ≤ q * (∫⁻ ω, X t ω ∂μ))
    (w : Nat) (hq : q < 1) (hNzero : N ≠ 0) (hNtop : N ≠ ∞)
    (prefix : ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, (∑ t ∈ Finset.range w, X t ω) ≤ (w : ℝ≥0∞) * N) :
    μ {ω | (w : ℝ≥0∞) * N + N / (1 - q) ≤ ∑' t : Nat, X t ω} ≤ q ^ w
